articles.headline: Bafana's Relebohile Mofokeng is bossing Belgium, and proving Hugo Broos very wrong
articles.description: Relebohile Mofokeng's flying start in Belgium for Royale Union St. Gilloise (RUSG) has put to rest former South Africa boss Hugo Broos' doubts over whether or not he would be ready for the Jupiler Pro League in the first six months.

images.name: Relebohile Mofokeng [1296x729]
images.caption: Relebohile Mofokeng scored his first home goal for Royale Union Saint-Gilloise on Saturday 12 September.
images.credit: BRUNO FAHY / BELGA / AFP via Getty Images

articles.headline: Suspect arrested after attack on Ghana and RUSG's Mohammed Fuseini in Brussels
articles.description: Police in Belgium have arrested a suspect after Ghana international and Royal Union Saint-Gilloise player Mohammed Fuseini was violently attacked and robbed in broad daylight in Brussels.

images.name: Mohammed Fuseini [1296x729]
images.caption: Royale Union Saint-Gilloise player Mohammed Fuseini is recovering after being robbed in Brussels on the weekend.
images.credit: Tomas Sisk / Photonews via Getty Images

articles.headline: Relebohile Mofokeng completes four-year deal with RUSG from Orlando Pirates
articles.description: Belgian Pro League side Royale Union Saint-Gilloise (RUSG) confirmed the signature of South Africa attacking midfielder Relebohile Mofokeng from Orlando Pirates on a four-year deal on Thursday.

images.name: Relebohile Mofokeng  [1296x729]
images.caption: Relebohile Mofokeng completed a four-year deal to the Belgian Pro League on Thursday.

articles.headline: Weekend predictions: Man City or Chelsea in FA Cup final?
articles.description: Silverware is on the line at Wembley, and in Scotland and Belgium. Who will claim the trophies? Julien Laurens makes his predictions.

images.name: Hearts fans react after the final whistle in the Scottish Premiership football match between Hearts and Rangers at Tynecastle Stadium in Edinburgh [1296x729]
images.caption: Hearts fans are hoping to see their team become the first team other than Celtic or Rangers to win the Scottish top flight since 1985.

images.credit: ANDY BUCHANAN / AFP via Getty Images
